import random

from txn_simulator import Workload
from workloads import WORKLOAD_1, WORKLOAD_2, WORKLOAD_3

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START

def get_best_schedule(workload, num_seqs):
    """Construct diverse low-cost prefixes, then apply global relocation descent."""
    import time

    n = workload.num_txns
    if n == 0:
        return 0, []

    # Three calls are made by the unchanged caller.  This leaves a small
    # process-wide margin while still allowing substantial true-cost search.
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 112.0
    cache = {}

    def cost(seq):
        key = tuple(seq)
        if key not in cache:
            cache[key] = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(list(seq))
        return cache[key]

    best_seq = list(range(n))
    best_cost = cost(best_seq)

    # Beam prefixes are complete, duplicate-free partial permutations.  Unlike
    # a one-path insertion order, several incompatible precedence choices are
    # retained until later transactions reveal which prefix is preferable.
    width = min(10, max(6, num_seqs))
    initial = []
    for txn in range(n):
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            break
        seq = [txn]
        initial.append((cost(seq), seq))

    if initial:
        initial.sort(key=lambda entry: (entry[0], tuple(entry[1])))
        beam = initial[:width]
    else:
        beam = [(best_cost, [])]

    while beam and len(beam[0][1]) < n and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        children = []
        stopped = False
        for _, prefix in beam:
            used = set(prefix)
            for txn in range(n):
                if txn in used:
                    continue
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    stopped = True
                    break
                child = prefix + [txn]
                children.append((cost(child), child))
            if stopped:
                break

        if not children:
            break
        children.sort(key=lambda entry: (entry[0], tuple(entry[1])))
        beam = children[:width]

    # A deadline can interrupt at any prefix depth.  Deterministic completion
    # makes every beam member a valid full schedule before comparison.
    for _, prefix in beam:
        used = set(prefix)
        complete = prefix + [txn for txn in range(n) if txn not in used]
        value = cost(complete)
        if value < best_cost:
            best_cost, best_seq = value, complete

    # Whole-neighborhood best-improvement relocation.  This directly tests
    # long-range precedence changes that bounded-distance moves miss.
    for _ in range(2):
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            break
        move_cost = best_cost
        move_seq = None

        for source in range(n):
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
            item = best_seq[source]
            rest = best_seq[:source] + best_seq[source + 1:]
            for target in range(n):
                if target == source:
                    continue
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    break
                candidate = rest[:target] + [item] + rest[target:]
                value = cost(candidate)
                if value < move_cost:
                    move_cost = value
                    move_seq = candidate

        if move_seq is None:
            break
        best_cost, best_seq = move_cost, move_seq

    return best_cost, best_seq

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

def get_random_costs():
    workload_size = 100
    workload = Workload(WORKLOAD_1)

    makespan1, schedule1 = get_best_schedule(workload, 10)
    cost1 = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(schedule1)

    workload2 = Workload(WORKLOAD_2)
    makespan2, schedule2 = get_best_schedule(workload2, 10)
    cost2 = workload2.get_opt_seq_cost(schedule2)

    workload3 = Workload(WORKLOAD_3)
    makespan3, schedule3 = get_best_schedule(workload3, 10)
    cost3 = workload3.get_opt_seq_cost(schedule3)
    print(cost1, cost2, cost3)
    return cost1 + cost2 + cost3, [schedule1, schedule2, schedule3]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    makespan, schedule = get_random_costs()
    print(f"Makespan: {makespan}")

    # Three calls are made by the unchanged caller.  This leaves a small
    # process-wide margin while still allowing substantial true-cost search.
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 112.0
    cache = {}

    def cost(seq):
        key = tuple(seq)
        if key not in cache:
            cache[key] = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(list(seq))
        return cache[key]

    best_seq = list(range(n))
    best_cost = cost(best_seq)

    # Beam prefixes are complete, duplicate-free partial permutations.  Unlike
    # a one-path insertion order, several incompatible precedence choices are
    # retained until later transactions reveal which prefix is preferable.
    width = min(10, max(6, num_seqs))
    initial = []
    for txn in range(n):
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            break
        seq = [txn]
        initial.append((cost(seq), seq))

    if initial:
        initial.sort(key=lambda entry: (entry[0], tuple(entry[1])))
        beam = initial[:width]
    else:
        beam = [(best_cost, [])]

    while beam and len(beam[0][1]) < n and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        children = []
        stopped = False
        for _, prefix in beam:
            used = set(prefix)
            for txn in range(n):
                if txn in used:
                    continue
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    stopped = True
                    break
                child = prefix + [txn]
                children.append((cost(child), child))
            if stopped:
                break

        if not children:
            break
        children.sort(key=lambda entry: (entry[0], tuple(entry[1])))
        beam = children[:width]

    # A deadline can interrupt at any prefix depth.  Deterministic completion
    # makes every beam member a valid full schedule before comparison.
    for _, prefix in beam:
        used = set(prefix)
        complete = prefix + [txn for txn in range(n) if txn not in used]
        value = cost(complete)
        if value < best_cost:
            best_cost, best_seq = value, complete

    # Whole-neighborhood best-improvement relocation.  This directly tests
    # long-range precedence changes that bounded-distance moves miss.
    for _ in range(2):
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            break
        move_cost = best_cost
        move_seq = None

        for source in range(n):
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
            item = best_seq[source]
            rest = best_seq[:source] + best_seq[source + 1:]
            for target in range(n):
                if target == source:
                    continue
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    break
                candidate = rest[:target] + [item] + rest[target:]
                value = cost(candidate)
                if value < move_cost:
                    move_cost = value
                    move_seq = candidate

        if move_seq is None:
            break
        best_cost, best_seq = move_cost, move_seq

    return best_cost, best_seq
